jin: Heads-up: planning cutover tonight 01:00 UTC for core-networking + IAM terraform apply. Requesting quiet window 00:45-02:15 UTC — please ack if you have blockers.

deploybot: @channel preflight started for change-id: release/2026-03/core-net. Run id: rb-3412. Will post plan output here.

sasha: ack. Landing release notes to the releases repo now — will paste link.

priya: FYI, we're pinning provider aws v5.12.0 and modules/vpc@v2.3 to avoid unexpected behavior from upstream changes during the canary.

ben: if we need a fast rollback, prepared command: 
```
terraform apply -var='force_rollforward=false' -target=module.control_plane.rollback
```
Also prepping a manual state-lock step post-apply (I'll share exact aws cli once I have it).

infra-bot: preflight results: plan OK overall. Note: 2 resources in modules/vpc show replace -> will cause short connectivity churn for associated peering (~45s/az). Plan excerpt: 
```
# modules/vpc.aws_vpc_peering_connection.peers
-/+ resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peers" {
  ...
}
```

sasha: release notes URL: https://git.company.releases/core-net/3412 — includes rollback steps, postmortem template, pinned module/provider list, and QA checklist. Please review before EOD.

jin: tagging oncall: @oncall please be ready to escalate at 01:05 UTC. If deploybot reports >5% redis errors or any auth surge we abort and run the rollback playbook in the notes.

deploybot: Confirming automation rules: deploybot will emit `deploybot: hold` and pause rollout if any of: redis error rate >10%, failed healthchecks >5% within 2 minutes, or step duration exceeds 12m. Canary traffic shift scheduled for 01:00 UTC.

priya: adding a short QA checklist into the release notes for live metrics to watch: latency p50/p95, token throughput, auth error rate, vpc reachability.

ben: I'll handle the state-lock/unlock and manual failover. Rollback plan: pin previous module version and run `terraform apply -target=module.rollback` then unpin when stable.

sasha: updated runbook with exact cli snippets and pasted a slack-ready rollback snippet into the release notes.

oncall: I'm on pager watch for the window and will open an incident channel if alarms hit. Will call the rollback if automated alarms cross thresholds.

jin: thanks team. Quick sync in #eng-infra at 00:50 UTC for a preflight check. :thumbsup:
